citation.authors: Suzuki K, Watanabe K, Futami-Suda S, Yano H, Motoyama M, Matsumura N, Igari Y, Suzuki T, Nakano H, Oba K
citation.title: The effects of postprandial glucose and insulin levels on postprandial endothelial function in subjects with normal glucose tolerance

population.description: 37 healthy Japanese volunteers aged 22 to 61 years (19 men, 18 women; mean age 31.8 ± 9.2 y), no family history of diabetes, no dyslipidaemia, diabetes, hypertension or other chronic disease, normal glucose tolerance on a 75-g OGTT (fasting PG < 6.1 mmol/L, 2-h < 7.8 mmol/L), normal blood pressure and lipids. Three separate groups, not a crossover: control (overnight fast only, n = 11), test meal (n = 12), 75-g oral glucose (n = 14); each arm carries its group's sex, age and BMI from Table 1. Pooled BMI is not printed. Some subjects were current smokers (abstained at least 8 h before the study).

protocols.name: fasted_control
protocols.description: Control group (overnight-fasting group, n = 11): a 30-minute fasted run-in standing for the single fasting draw, which was made at 9 a.m. after at least 12 h of overnight fasting (Methods, Study design); the arm ends at the draw, so start_hour = 9.0 - 0.5 = 8.5 and prefast_hours = 12 - 0.5 = 11.5 (12 h is the stated lower bound). No meal, water only. Group's sex, age and BMI from Table 1 (7 of 11 men; age 33.4 ± 8.4 y; BMI 21.94 ± 1.88 kg/m2, mean ± SD).

protocols.name: fasted_tm
protocols.description: Test-meal (TM) group before its meal (n = 12): a 30-minute fasted run-in standing for the single fasting draw, which was made at 9 a.m. after at least 12 h of overnight fasting (Methods, Study design); the arm ends at the draw, so start_hour = 9.0 - 0.5 = 8.5 and prefast_hours = 12 - 0.5 = 11.5 (12 h is the stated lower bound). No meal, water only. Group's sex, age and BMI from Table 1 (6 of 12 men; age 28.5 ± 5.1 y; BMI 22.53 ± 2.46 kg/m2, mean ± SD).

protocols.name: fasted_og
protocols.description: 75-g oral glucose (OG) group before its load (n = 14): a 30-minute fasted run-in standing for the single fasting draw, which was made at 9 a.m. after at least 12 h of overnight fasting (Methods, Study design); the arm ends at the draw, so start_hour = 9.0 - 0.5 = 8.5 and prefast_hours = 12 - 0.5 = 11.5 (12 h is the stated lower bound). No meal, water only. Group's sex, age and BMI from Table 1 (6 of 14 men; age 33.4 ± 11.9 y; BMI 20.71 ± 2.28 kg/m2, mean ± SD).

protocols.name: ogtt
protocols.description: OG group (n = 14): 75 g glucose (Table 2: carbohydrate 75 g, lipid 0 g, 300 kcal) after the fasting draw at 9 a.m. following at least 12 h of overnight fasting; blood at 0 (fasting), 30, 60 and 120 min after loading. The load is put at minute 0 with the fasting draw; 9 a.m. is the stated time of the fasting evaluation, the load followed it at a clock time not printed, so start_hour is assumed; prefast_hours 12 is the stated lower bound. Protein is not listed for the glucose load and is 0. Group's sex, age and BMI from Table 1 (6 of 14 men; age 33.4 ± 11.9 y; BMI 20.71 ± 2.28 kg/m2, mean ± SD).
